subject: Retention carveout request + capacity onramp (SOC 2 renewal)
messages:
From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@greenfieldpay.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@greenfieldpay.com
Date: 2028-03-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 renewal: retention carve-out ask + burst onramp

Hi Nikhil —

Quick context: Greenfield is approaching our SOC 2 renewal and our internal auditors want a short carve-out to retain 24 months of auth/log data for a scoped service only. Our procurement team also expects a Q4 throughput onramp if we can guarantee the retention window and a staggered evidence handoff.

Can Redwood confirm support for:
- A limited 24-month retention carve-out for the payments-infra service (single-tenant logical carve-out)
- A staged evidence fanout (week 1: metadata + control narratives; week 2: truncated logs; week 3: full evidence)
- A short-term burst capacity plan (reserve + 3-week burst) tied to the renewal effective date

I attached an initial evidence index and a matrix showing which logs we need preserved. Budget team asked for an estimate of the incremental seat/retention charge so they can sign an amendment.

Are you available for a 30-min sync this week? Prefer Thurs morning PT.

Thanks,
Asha Menon
Head of Security Operations
Greenfield Payments

Attachments: evidence_index.xlsx (stub), retention_matrix.csv (stub)

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Menon <asha.menon@greenfieldpay.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-03-29T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 renewal: retention carve-out ask + burst onramp

Asha — thanks for the clear ask and the index. We can support a scoped 24-month retention carve-out for a specific service path; below is a proposed working plan to keep the auditors happy while limiting cost/regulatory surface area: 

Proposed plan (high level):
1) Retention carve-out: create a logical retention policy that applies to the payments-infra model route only. Logs will be tagged at ingestion; retention TTL = 24 months for tagged artifacts, default TTL remains as agreed in base contract.
2) Evidence fanout cadence: week 1 metadata + narrative export (redacted), week 2 truncated logs for sampling (30 days of high-priority windows), week 3 full evidence export to secure share (encrypted bucket access + HMAC).
3) Burst onramp: reserve N GPUs (we'll provide numbers once workload profile confirmed) + 3-week burst window. We can do autoscale with guaranteed baseline throughput and a defined fallback.

Action items for us:
- Kimberly: produce a line-item estimate for the incremental retention storage + burst reservation and a contract amendment template.
- Marissa: confirm operational runbook for evidence exports and the secure delivery method (S3 presigned + carrier key or GDrive share).
- Nikhil (me): confirm tagging mechanism and what needs instrumenting in Greenfield's routing config; provide a one-page ATO-friendly control narrative.

I can do Thurs 9:00–9:30 PT. Kimberly / Marissa — can you join?

—Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Date: 2028-03-30T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 renewal: retention carve-out ask + burst onramp

Thanks — looping in budgeting/quote info. A few clarifying Qs before the call so I can size the amendment: 
- Can you confirm the expected 99th percentile token throughput for peak days during the 3-week burst (ballpark)?
- Is the carve-out limited to a single region (we prefer region-scoped retention to reduce cross-region replication)?
- Are there any encryption/KMS constraints for the archived logs (customer-managed key vs Redwood KMS)?

Preliminary pricing approach:
- Retention: monthly $/GB for the 24mo TTL on tagged logs; we may offer a volume discount at >50TB.
- Burst reservation: fixed monthly fee to reserve capacity + per-second overage during burst period.

If you can answer the three Qs above we’ll produce a 2-line price estimate and a short amendment draft. Also planning to attach a redline-ready amendment to ease procurement.

Kimberly Park
Principal Product Finance
Redwood Inference

Date: 2028-04-02T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 renewal: retention carve-out ask + burst onramp

Appreciate the quick turnaround, all. Quick answers: 
- Peak throughput (estimate): 1200 RPS token-equivalent peak (99th) for payment reconciliation windows — planning conservatively; will share a short profile later today.
- Region: US-West only for the carve-out — we cannot replicate outside yet due to data residency rules.
- KMS: customer-managed keys required for the archived bucket — we'll share key policy.

Asha
Asha Menon
Head of Security Operations
Greenfield Payments
